---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear description of the problem.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen.

**Alternatives considered**
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Does it change a verdict?**
If this would change what the engine answers for an existing case, say which case
and why the new answer is the correct one. Behavior changes to the decision core
need a golden-case update in the same change.
